gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-antic: Bruno Ace SC spaces its letters out like beads on a long thread. Its wide-open shapes make the heading loud and unmistakable, while Antic, drawn with a single nib in sans-serif form, simply carries the words along.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-ar-one-sans: AR One Sans reads like brush ends lifted away before each curve closes, a modern sans-serif with a lightly handmade feel. Over a long stretch it moves along smoothly, never snagging.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-assistant: Assistant keeps its mouths open on c, e and a, giving the body a friendly, uncluttered face under the heading. Bruno Ace SC earns its place big and brief.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-asta-sans: Bruno Ace SC has round bowls and open apertures with no calligraphic thinning anywhere. Asta Sans follows with tubelike, constant-weight lines, so a longer passage goes down smoothly and approachably, with every e clearly formed.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bai-jamjuree: Bai Jamjuree sets light, unpinched round letters with no thick-and-thin modulation at all, approachable and easy on the eye. And Bruno Ace SC, with its beads-on-a-thread spacing, gives it a showy, expressive neighbor that makes the quiet body feel even quieter.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-barlow: Spaced-out, techy and bold in attitude, Bruno Ace SC leads with open shapes, and Barlow follows in neon-tube strokes. Both stay wide open.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biz-udgothic: Bruno Ace SC draws its lines with a pencil-line consistency and spreads its letters wide for a distinctive look up top. BIZ UDGothic then lets a wide channel into every bowl keep the sans-serif text crisp.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic gives every round letter a clear channel and lavish spacing. Its biggest strength is how much room it leaves, which lets Bruno Ace SC, with rounds and stems in one weight, stand out as the showier voice.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bpmf-huninn: Modern in spirit, Bruno Ace SC strings its open letters out like beads on a long thread and works best big and short. Bpmf Huninn follows with a single-weight outline feel and a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-sc-gf-bpmf-zihi-kai-std: Bpmf Zihi Kai Std keeps its counters connected to the outside, with a restrained swell in curves. Bruno Ace SC, drawn like rod stock with identical horizontals and verticals, feels mechanical beside that softer, more approachable plain sans.
